text:
DeployBot: Canary rollout to prod-usw2 at 25% traffic. p95 latency +38% vs baseline; error rate 2.3% (>1.0% threshold). Suggested action: HOLD and consider rollback. /rollout state: hold

Alex R: seeing the deploybot alert. Anyone else seeing increased 4xx on api/generate? /me looking at logs

Maria C: confirmed 4xx spike correlated with v3.5.1. Errors look like tokenization mismatch on short prompts. I'm pulling logs.

Jamal: recommend manual rollback to v3.5.0 for affected route only. Criteria: p95 back to baseline and error <0.5% within 10m. + notify customers in change window.

Sophie: Agree. Also we need release-notes freeze and announce to sales/support. Can someone draft a short blurb? :eyes:

Alex R: Is auto-rollback enabled? DeployBot, what's the configured action for error>1%?

DeployBot: Auto-rollback is disabled for prod dedicated pools. Current policy: notify + hold. Manual rollback recommended. :warning:

Maria C: I'll run targeted revert for api/generate route. Command: ```deployctl rollback --service inference-api --route /generate --to v3.5.0 --explain```

Jamal: +1. After revert, run smoke: `curl -sS -X POST https://int-api/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'` and check kvcache hits.

Sophie: Lina, here's draft for support: 'Heads up: we reverted inference runtime to v3.5.0 due to transient errors affecting short prompts. No data loss. We'll follow up with timeline.' Thoughts?

Lina (PM): LGTM. Add: 'If you see degraded performance, open ticket with #support and tag account team.' I'll send to sales.

Alex R: executing rollback now. tagging oncall. Oncall-Bot, please escalate if rollback fails.

Oncall-Bot: @oncall will be paged if any CI or deploy job fails. Rolling rollback job queued: job/rollback-2465001234-1.

DeployBot: Rollback job started. progress: 0% -> 42% -> 100%. Canary traffic restored to v3.5.0.

Maria C: Post-rollback metrics: p95 back to normal, error 0.3%. KV cache warm-up in progress. I'll monitor for 30m.

Sophie: I'm freezing release notes for v3.5.1 and adding a NOTE: 'reverted for short-prompt tokenization bug; fixed version forthcoming'

Jamal: Follow-up action: create follow-up ticket to investigate tokenizer edge-case, assign to eng-ml; add regression test.

Alex R: Thanks team. I'll update ops-runbook and close thread once stable. :thumbsup:
